author: PumpkinEater31
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: PumpkinEater31
quote: Regardless of what anyone says, this game is an absolute masterpiece—it doesn't have a single flaw. The music, action sequences, mission design, graphics, and everything else I haven't even mentioned are all superb; it is leagues ahead of other Rockstar Games titles, as well as every other game out there. Let the nintendo fanboys seethe all they want—it has completely blown their *Ocarina of Time* out of the water. Like it or not, that’s the truth—though I suppose it’s easy enough to attack with bot-generated comments. Only thing we need now is a story dlcs based on endings
